# CV bullet points

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_docs.py from results/**/*.json. Every number traces to results/. -->

- Built a tested Python experimentation toolkit (SRM checks, CUPED, Lan-DeMets sequential boundaries, IPW/AIPW, clustered DiD, T/X-learner uplift) and validated each estimator by Monte Carlo simulation against known effects. For example, sequential boundaries held the false-positive rate at 5.0%, against 19.2% for naive peeking across 10 looks.
- Re-audited an observational mobile-vs-desktop conversion analysis on 873,204 Google Analytics sessions. Added visitor-clustered SEs and propensity adjustment on session-start covariates only, and found that a suspected internal-traffic segment (49% of desktop conversions) roughly halved the adjusted gap (-1.25 pp to -0.67 pp). Recommended a randomized test sized by power analysis instead of a redesign launch.
- Built an uplift-targeting policy on 1,001,957 Criteo users with honest train/validation/test splits. Targeting the top 20% earned $6.74 per 1,000 held-out users against $0.22 for random targeting under stated cost assumptions. Shipped as a CLI report and Streamlit app that refuse to interpret results when trust checks fail.
